content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) is a residential girls' education scheme run under Samagra Shiksha, Uttar Pradesh. The Bulandshahr district office has invited applications to fill vacant teaching and non-teaching posts in its 16 KGBVs, including schools upgraded to senior secondary (Class 9–12) level. Here is a quick summary of the KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026: Register for Job Alerts

160 posts (144 in upgraded KGBVs + 16 in Class 6–8 KGBVs)

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026 vacancies are split into two categories: posts for upgraded KGBVs offering Class 9 to 12, and posts for the original KGBVs offering Class 6 to 8. In total, KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026 offers 160 posts across teaching and non-teaching categories in 16 Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas of the district.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026 is limited to women candidates only, and the required qualification differs by post. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification for the complete, post-wise eligibility clauses before applying. Not specified in the official notification: exact university-level equivalence tables and additional alternate qualifications for each PGT subject are listed in detail in the full notification; candidates are advised to verify their eligibility against the complete document before applying. Candidates who have completed their graduation, post-graduation, or B.Ed. can also explore more Teaching Government Jobs and B.Ed Qualified Jobs available across India.

rows.minimum_qualification: Trained M.A. (Hindi/English) or M.Sc. (Physics/Chemistry/Zoology/Botany/Mathematics/Computer Science) from a recognized university, with a minimum of 4 years' teaching experience in Classes 9–12, or equivalent qualification and experience as detailed in the notification
M.A. in Hindi with Sanskrit at graduation level, trained (B.Ed. or equivalent)
Postgraduate degree (M.A.) in English from a recognized university, trained (B.Ed./L.T. Diploma or equivalent)
M.A./M.Sc. Mathematics, or B.A.(Hons.)/B.Sc.(Hons.) with a three-year Mathematics course, trained
M.Sc. in Botany or Zoology, or equivalent Life Science postgraduate qualification, trained
M.Sc. Chemistry, or B.Sc.(Hons.) three-year Chemistry course, or equivalent, trained
M.Sc. Physics, or equivalent postgraduate diploma in Physics, trained
M.Tech/B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science), M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science), or equivalent DOEACC/postgraduate diploma qualification, trained
High School with Science subjects and a Diploma in Laboratory Technique, or Intermediate (Science) from a recognized board
Intermediate pass, with Computer Science as a subject or a CCC certificate from NIELIT/DOEACC or equivalent; Hindi typing minimum 25 wpm and English typing minimum 30 wpm on computer
Postgraduate degree with B.Ed. (as per the amended qualification notified for Care Taker)
Trained graduate with B.Ed. in the relevant subject, as prescribed under Samagra Shiksha guidelines
Graduate with relevant qualification, as prescribed in the notification

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be calculated as on 1 April of the selection year, based on High School/Class 8 certificates. The maximum age for continued service in a KGBV is 60 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories will be applicable as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly honorarium (subject to EPF deduction as applicable) ranging from ₹5,978 for Assistant Cook to ₹30,000 for Principal. The exact honorarium for each post is listed in the vacancy details tables above.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026 differs by post category: Teaching and most non-teaching posts (Principal, PGT, Computer Science Teacher, Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Care Taker, Full-Time/Part-Time Teachers, Accountant): Selection is merit-based, using a weightage system on academic marks — High School (10%), Intermediate (10%), Graduation (20%), Post-graduation (20%), and Training/B.Ed. (30%). Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar posts : Selection is through Interview. A District-Level Selection Committee headed by the Chief Development Officer (CDO), Bulandshahr, will conduct the selection process, with a psychologist included as a subject expert for candidate counselling. Document verification is mandatory for all selected candidates before honorarium payment begins.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for submission and later verification: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format High School marksheet and certificate Intermediate marksheet and certificate Graduation marksheet and certificate B.Ed./Training certificate and marksheet (where applicable) Domicile/residence certificate Aadhaar card Category certificate (if applicable) Disability certificate (if applicable) Passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible women candidates should follow these steps for KGBV Bulandshahr Apply Online / offline process: Download the prescribed application form from the official Bulandshahr district website: https://bulandshahr.nic.in/ Fill in all required details, including the KGBV school choice, post/subject applied for, personal details, and educational qualification table. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents and certificates. Send the completed application form by Registered Post only to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Bulandshahr. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 10 August 2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Apply Online
content_sections.text: The notification does not provide an online application (apply online) facility. Applications must be submitted offline through Registered Post only, along with the prescribed application form and required documents, addressed to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Bulandshahr.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bulandshahr Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All posts under this notification are reserved for women candidates only. Engagement is purely contractual, for a period of 11 months 29 days, renewable annually subject to satisfactory performance evaluation. Applications must be sent only by Registered Post; no other mode (hand delivery, email, or online submission) is mentioned in the notification. Selected candidates must complete document verification before receiving their honorarium. Providing false or incorrect information may lead to termination of the service contract, recovery of paid honorarium, and registration of an FIR against the candidate. For further details, candidates may contact the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Bulandshahr, on any working day. faq.question: Q1. What is KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Basic Education Officer, Bulandshahr, to fill 160 contractual posts — including Principal, PGT, Lab Assistant, Care Taker, teachers, and support staff — across 16 Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas in Bulandshahr district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 160 vacancies are available - 144 posts in upgraded KGBVs (Class 9–12) and 16 posts in KGBVs offering Class 6–8.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 10 August 2026, up to 5:00 PM, by Registered Post.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women candidates meeting the post-specific educational qualification and age criteria are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for KGBV Bulandshahr posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Class 8 pass (Peon, Chowkidar, Cook) to postgraduate/B.Ed. qualifications (Principal, PGT subjects, Care Taker). See the eligibility section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30–45 years for Principal and 25–45 years for all other posts, as on 1 April of the selection year.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from https://bulandshahr.nic.in/, fill it, attach the required documents, and send it by Registered Post to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Bulandshahr, before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KGBV Bulandshahr Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Teaching and most non-teaching posts are selected on merit (weighted academic marks); Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar posts are selected through Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for KGBV Bulandshahr posts?
faq.answer: Monthly honorarium ranges from ₹5,978 (Assistant Cook) to ₹30,000 (Principal), depending on the post.
